page.overview:
Who is Bolt?

Bolt is a minor character in Invincible, debuting from Season 3 and onwards.

He is one of the superheroes who joined the Invincible War and is a member of the Capes Inc.

Bolt wears a sleek, skin-tight light gray bodysuit that highlights his muscular, athletic build. His costume features bold blue accents, including gloves, boots, a high-collar chest covering, and a blue flowing cape.

A blue belt with a lightning bolt buckle completes the look. He is bald with dark eyebrows and a strong, defined jawline.
